_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: <operatorAppId>-S<nnn>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

operatorAppId.description: Reference to u_mes_sys_operatorApp._id: the parent document this one belongs to

operatorAppName.description: Display value of operatorAppId, copied from u_mes_sys_operatorApp.name

stepNo.description: Step number within the parent record

name.description: Name of the operator app step; used as its display value in other collections

workInstructionName.description: Display value of workInstructionId, copied from u_mes_prd_workInstruction.title

inspectionPlanName.description: Display value of inspectionPlanId, copied from u_mes_qlt_inspectionPlan.name

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
